risks.title: Display Glass Demand and Pricing
risks.score_rationale: Corning's Display Technologies segment depends on cyclical TV, PC and monitor demand and on long-term LCD glass price erosion. Item 1A flags display panel maker concentration and price pressure.
risks.summary: Weak end demand for TVs/PCs or accelerated price declines in LCD glass could compress Display margins and reduce segment cash flow.

risks.title: Customer Concentration and Wireless Carrier Spend
risks.score_rationale: Optical Communications depends heavily on hyperscaler and Tier-1 carrier capex. Apple is a key Specialty Materials customer; loss or repricing would be material.
risks.summary: A small number of large customers across Optical and Specialty Materials drive a significant share of revenues; cuts to carrier or hyperscaler capex would directly impact volumes.

risks.title: FX Exposure (Yen, Won, Euro)
risks.score_rationale: Display Technologies prices in JPY/KRW while costs are largely USD-denominated. Yen weakness historically pressures Display segment net income; Corning uses long-dated hedges.
risks.summary: Adverse movements in the Japanese yen, Korean won and euro materially impact reported Display revenues and consolidated earnings despite hedging.

risks.title: Capital Intensity and Capacity Utilization
risks.score_rationale: Glass melting, optical fiber and ceramic substrate plants are highly capital intensive with high fixed costs. Underutilization (e.g. AutoGlass, fiber 2023-24) materially hurts margins.
risks.summary: High fixed costs of glass tanks and optical fiber plants mean utilization swings have outsized impact on margins; capacity additions ahead of demand risk impairment.

risks.title: Technology Transitions (OLED, AI Optical, EV Filters)
risks.score_rationale: OLED substitution, transition to higher-speed optical, and EV adoption rate all influence segment trajectories. Failure to retain spec wins (e.g. Gorilla Glass on flagship phones) would impair growth.
risks.summary: Failure to win design positions in next-gen display, optical and automotive applications could erode share and necessitate impairments of legacy assets.

risks.title: Geopolitical and China Exposure
risks.score_rationale: Substantial manufacturing, JVs and revenues in China, plus export-control sensitivity in optical and specialty materials. U.S.-China tensions, tariffs and export controls are explicitly listed in Item 1A.
risks.summary: Tariffs, export controls and broader U.S.-China decoupling could disrupt supply chains, customer relationships and revenue flows from China.
